_comment: Serving names and speech rates for en_AU-librivox-medium, keyed by the
LibriVox narrator name that piper recorded in the trained .onnx.json.
Edit freely -- this is the only place serving names and rates live.
Speaker IDs are NEVER written here: deploy/2-voice-map.py reads those
from the trained config, because piper assigns them at training time and
they do not follow the export roster order.
A value can be a plain name, or an object with a length_scale.
length_scale is piper's speech-rate control, in the config's `inference`
block. 1.0 is the trained rate; HIGHER IS SLOWER. For reference, the
en_GB-vctk voice already on this server ships at 1.4.
Rates here are set per narrator because pacing turned out to be a property
of how each volunteer actually reads, not of how much audio they
contributed -- the model reproduces their natural speed faithfully.
Assessed by ear 2026-09-20: tully and clancy rush, marlo sometimes does,
everyone else is fine at the trained rate.
